thread:
Samira (Recruiter): Candidate for SWE2 (EU) just told me they have a competitor counter and need an earlier start to align family relocation. They asked if we can bridge pay or start benefits earlier. They need a firm answer by EOD to give notice.
Anya (People Ops): please paste redacted numbers + candidate requested start date
Tom (Hiring Manager): Current offer: base 
c108,000 + 10% target bonus, band top 
c116,000. Competitor offered 
c123,000 base. Candidate requests either base match or a temporary cash parity for 3 months (approx 
c5,000/mo) and wants to start 2026-04-01 instead of 2026-04-20 to sync moves. Also asks that health coverage start day 1 because spouse's coverage lapses.
Ruth (Comp): Policy: we avoid permanently raising base for counter offers. Standard approach is a timeboxed cash parity or one-time sign-on. Recommend 3-month temporary top-up or a lump sign-on equivalent. Must have Comp memo, VP Eng + Finance + Legal approvals, and an explicit review date. Benefits activation earlier than policy requires exception routed to Benefits/Legal.
Payroll: Note payroll cutoff for April is 2026-04-03. If payment is to hit first payroll we need paperwork by 2026-04-01. Monthly top-ups can be issued as lump on first payroll to simplify.
Legal: We'll need clawback language for any provisional cash and clear benefit eligibility wording. If we accelerate benefits, confirm carrier acceptance and enrollment timing. I can draft conditional clause quickly.
offer-bot: Automated check: "Action requested: temporary cash parity OR one-time sign-on + earlier benefits effective date + start date change. Required approvals: comp@, vp-engi@, finance@, legal@, benefits-admin@. Suggested window: <=90 days. Candidate deadline: EOD"
Tom (Hiring Manager): This is blocking the EU rollout pilot. I can signoff on hiring discretionary to fund parity for 3 months. I'll add business justification and urgency note for VP.
Anya (People Ops): Draft proposal for candidate messaging: keep base 
c108,000, add provisional monthly top-up 
c5,000 for up to 3 months payable as lump on first payroll if start <= 2026-04-01; benefits: request expedited enrollment effective day 1 pending carrier OK; condition: final comp decision by 2026-06-01, repayment clause pro rata if uplift not approved or if employee leaves within 6 months. Sending to Ruth/Legal/Finance now.
Ruth (Comp): I'll prepare an exception memo recommending the 3-month top-up and include timelines for final review. If VP approves, Comp will record the provisional uplift and Finance will arrange payroll coding.
Finance: We can do lump payment on first payroll if paperwork is in before cutoff. For expedited benefits, we'll need a confirmation from Benefits admin and potential retro accounting. Approvers required.
VP Eng: I tentatively approve the provisional cash parity given business criticality, pending Finance verification and Legal clawback language. Please route the memo; I can sign within 2 hours.
Legal: Drafted clawback and conditional benefits language, sending to People Ops. Note: benefit carriers may require enrollment by first of month; we'll escalate to Benefits admin.
Samira (Recruiter): I'll tell candidate we have a provisional plan being routed for approvals and expect final confirmation by tomorrow AM so they can plan notice/relocation. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Anya (People Ops): Logging exception in tracker and attaching redacted comps. Will issue "provisional pending approvals" note to candidate to unblock logistics.
